function flatten(value, prefix = "") {
  if (typeof value === "string") return [[prefix, value]];
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, child]) =>
      flatten(child, prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key),
    );
  }
  return [];
}

const enLeaves = flatten(en);
const huLeaves = new Map(flatten(hu));
const keyFor = (kind, source) => createHash("sha256").update(`${kind}${source}`).digest("hex");

const entries = {};
for (const [path, text] of enLeaves) {
  const translated = huLeaves.get(path);
  if (translated !== undefined) entries[keyFor("text", text)] = translated;
}

const outPath = join(import.meta.dirname, "..", "i18n-cache", "hu.chrome.json");
writeFileSync(outPath, `${JSON.stringify({ version: 1, entries }, null, 2)}\n`);
console.log(`Seeded ${Object.keys(entries).length} entries into ${outPath}`);

{"content": "---
"@pantoken/docs": minor
"@pantoken/scaffold": patch
"@pantoken/ai": patch
---

Expanded the docs site's i18n infrastructure from 2 locales (`root`/`hu`) to all 44 Canvas locales
(`@pantoken/i18n`'s `CANVAS_LOCALES`). `.vitepress/i18n.ts` now derives `DocsLocale` and route
structure from `CANVAS_LOCALES` instead of a hardcoded union, and splits translatable UI chrome into
a content-addressed `<locale>.chrome.json` cache (see the new `docs:chrome:locales*` scripts and
`translate-chrome.ts`), falling back to English until a locale is translated. `build-api-locales.ts`
and `check-locale-parity.ts` now loop over every non-root locale instead of only `hu`, and the
`glossary`/`ai` translation adapters take a target locale instead of hardcoding Hungarian (the
glossary's structural-term dictionary is still `hu`-only; other locales pass through untranslated
terms until someone adds their glossary). The nav's language flyout is now a searchable `<select>`
instead of a flat link list, which scales to 44+ options with built-in browser type-to-search.
`@pantoken/scaffold` and `@pantoken/ai`'s `translate`/`check-drift` scripts now target every Canvas
locale (matching `@pantoken/web-components`'s existing pattern) instead of only `hu`.

Actual AI translation of the 43 new locales' guides/API docs is a follow-up: run
`vp run docs:locales:translate` (or `:agy`) to fill in real translations; until then, untranslated
locales render the English source as a passthrough.

content.text:
## Summary

**Root cause:** the earlier session on this branch only produced a *plan* — no code was ever written. That's why `vpr docs:dev` still showed 2 languages and the old link list instead of a select.

**What I implemented (full infra plan):**
- `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`: `DocsLocale` now derives from `@pantoken/i18n`'s `CANVAS_LOCALES` (44 locales) instead of a hardcoded `"root" | "hu"` union. Translatable UI chrome (`UiStrings`) is separated from structural per-locale metadata (route prefixes, BCP47 tag, direction), and merges a content-addressed `<locale>.chrome.json` cache over English defaults — untranslated locales render in English until translated. `LOCALES` is computed lazily behind a Proxy so merely importing the module (for locale lists) stays I/O-free.
- New `docs/scripts/translate-chrome.ts` + `docs:chrome:locales*` scripts to translate that UI chrome, wired into `docs:locales:translate`/`:agy`.
- `docs/scripts/api-translation.ts`: both adapters now take a target locale instead of hardcoding Hungarian (glossary dictionary is still `hu`-only; other locales pass through structural terms untranslated until someone adds their glossary).
- `build-api-locales.ts` and `check-locale-parity.ts` now loop over every non-root locale instead of only `hu`. `check-locale-drift.ts` gained a chrome-drift check.
- `VPNavBarExtra.vue`: swapped the link-list flyout for a real `<select>` (verified live — 44 languages render correctly).
- `packages/scaffold` and `ai/pantoken-ai`'s `translate`/`check-drift` scripts now target all Canvas locales (matching `@pantoken/web-components`'s existing pattern).
- Generated guide-page clones and chrome-string caches for all 44 locales via the default `glossary` adapter (seeded `hu`'s existing curated translations first so nothing regressed).
- Added a changeset; `vp check` and `vp test` (300 tests) pass.

**Follow-ups still needed (documented in the changeset):**
1. `vp run docs:api:locales` (or `:claude`/`:agy`) hasn't been run — it's expensive (full TypeDoc clone per locale) so I didn't run it in this session. Until then, `docs:check:locales`/`docs:build` will fail on missing API pages for the 43 new locales.
2. Real AI translation of guides/chrome/API content is a follow-up (`vp run docs:locales:translate` or `:agy`); everything currently renders as English passthrough via the `glossary` adapter.
